question_text: Describe how you diagnose a motherboard that intermittently fails to boot.
expected_answer: You test power delivery inspect capacitors check component seating and rule out connected hardware

question_text: Explain how you identify a CPU that is throttling under load.
expected_answer: You monitor temperatures check cooling performance and verify thermal paste condition

question_text: Describe how you troubleshoot a system with recurring GPU crashes.
expected_answer: You test drivers check power supply stability monitor temperatures and test the GPU in another system

question_text: Explain how you diagnose a computer that randomly loses power.
expected_answer: You test the power supply inspect the motherboard and check for shorts or failing components

question_text: Describe how you identify a failing NVMe or SSD.
expected_answer: You check SMART data look for slow writes and test for sudden disconnects during operation

question_text: Explain how you troubleshoot a system with corrupted BIOS settings.
expected_answer: You reset CMOS update BIOS and test stability after restoring default configuration

question_text: Describe how you diagnose a laptop with intermittent charging.
expected_answer: You test the charger inspect the port check battery health and verify power controller behavior

question_text: Explain how you identify a faulty expansion card.
expected_answer: You test the card in another system check slot integrity and monitor for driver or hardware failures

question_text: Describe how you troubleshoot a server experiencing thermal spikes.
expected_answer: You inspect airflow check fan performance verify sensor accuracy and test cooling redundancy

question_text: Explain how you diagnose a system that fails only after long uptime.
expected_answer: You check memory stability monitor temperatures test power consistency and look for component fatigue
